layout.stepHeader: uint32 frame, float32 timeStep, float32[3] frameOffset
layout.pre: per body float32[19]: position(3) rotationXYZW(4) linearVelocity(3) angularVelocity(3) interpolationLinearVelocity(3) interpolationAngularVelocity(3)
layout.post: per body float32[13]: position(3) rotationXYZW(4) linearVelocity(3) angularVelocity(3)
layout.stepOrder: stepHeader, pre for every body, post for every body, contacts; repeated per step
layout.contacts: uint32 count, then per contact: int32 bodyA, int32 bodyB (-1 when not recorded), float32[9]: pointOnB(3) normalOnB(3) distance appliedImpulse combinedFriction
